title: Nourishing Yeasty Slovakian Dough Bowl
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring a yeasty dough bowl filled with ssamjang and candy, perfect for a solo dinner, and sugar-free friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased earthenware bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a bowl shape.
Spread the ssamjang evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Arrange the sugar free candy on top of the ssamjang.
Drizzle the olive oil over the candy and dough.
Bake the dough bowl in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Remove the dough bowl from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the nourishing yeasty Slovakian dough bowl hot, garnished with a sliced egg if desired.
